cues.text: each level adds a new idea
a giant project built in stages
clues lock in as you solve them
each chapter is a new genre
a flowchart shows paths you missed
a mentor helps from beyond death
a new lens reveals hidden things
a puzzle box opens layer by layer
an heir takes over after death
map opens as you fix towers
your boat grows into a town
companions leave one at a time
the world darkens as you kill
the dead return in the next wave
the hero learns to hope again
the past comes out piece by piece
the world reflects good or evil
the world remembers your last run
your death shapes your next run
your politics form from your choices
